title: The Dragon Knights
text: A company of knights on wyverns patrols the Reaches, their mounts' wings beating up dust as they land around you. Their armour is scorched black. Their captain lifts her visor, scarred and unsmiling, and demands to know your business here.

options.label: Tell the captain the truth, and hope it is enough to satisfy her.

outcomes.text: She nods, and they escort you a way, wings beating overhead, and nothing dares come near.
They do not believe you, and lower their lances.

options.label: The smoothest bluffs about your business here, and keeps a straight face.

outcomes.text: They salute, and take off in a storm of dust, and never think to ask again.

options.label: The strongest challenges the captain, and lets steel settle the question.

outcomes.text: The captain yields, scarred face unreadable, and gives up her lance.
The captain wins, and does not bother to look back at what she left in the dust.
